description.narrative: Empowering European citizens to speak up against corruption: Whistleblowers are important players in national and European efforts to detect and prevent corruption. This project aims to prevent corruption in high-risk areas, in the European Union (EU), such as public procurement, healthcare, interaction between business and politics, by empowering people to speak up about it to those who can take action. The project approach includes: citizen outreach, quality technical and legal aid, safe online platforms, and developing and sharing best practice whistleblowing tools with public and private organisations.Value of contract: EUR 431,039.76
